scope.purpose: Turn a setting on or off with immediate effect (notifications, dark mode, a feature flag).
useCases: A settings list with the label at the start and the switch aligned at the end (labelPosition start).
A single setting next to its description.
A compact switch in a table row with hideLabel.
exclusions: Choices confirmed by a form submission, required or validated: Checkbox.
On/off text or icons inside the track.
Loading state while the setting is saved: open to a later change.
alternatives: Checkbox when the choice is submitted later.
RadioGroup or SegmentedControl (later) for more than two values.

checks.note: Schema, consistency, token coverage (44 paths) in 18 contexts and accepted components; check-foundations passes (425 roles, 2196 contrast checks, 0 failures). Intrinsic rules: manual review at the contract gate.
1620 contrast records on the contrastScope backdrops in 18 contexts, 0 failures; minimum active text 5.11.

decisionsTaken: No invalid and no required: a switch applies immediately; the condition axis is default, hover, readonly, disabled.

Shares color.choice.* with Checkbox and Radio: off is an outlined track with a neutral thumb (field placeholder color, at least 4.5:1 on the field surface), on an accent track with a contrasting thumb.

New sizes size.switch.{sm,md,lg} = 16, 20, 24 px for the track block size; the inline size (2 x block - 4 x border width: 28, 36, 44 px) and the thumb (block - 4 x border width) are derived in rules, no further token.
labelPosition end (default, like Checkbox) or start (settings rows: the switch aligns at the inline end of the row).
Thumb and colors animate over motion.duration.base with motion.easing.standard; instant under reduced motion.
nextAction: Contract gate (grouped wave 2 review): present the contract, the token additions and the open decisions; record the approval with digests, then implement (ggb-svelte).
